paragraphs.en: HATI Construction regularly publishes tender opportunities for suppliers, contractors, and consultants. All tenders are open and transparent, following international procurement standards.
paragraphs.am: HATI ግንባታ ለአቅራቢዎች፣ ለኮንትራክተሮች እና ለአማካሪዎች የጨረታ እድሎችን በየጊዜው ያሳትማል። ሁሉም ጨረታዎች ክፍት እና ግልጽ ናቸው፣ ዓለም አቀፍ የግዥ ደረጃዎችን ይከተላሉ።
paragraphs.om: HATI Ijaarsa yeroo hundaaf tanziiwwan daldaltoota, kontiraaktoota, fi gorsitootaaf babal'isa. Tanziiwwan hunduu banaa fi ifa dha, sadarkaa karaa barbaachisaa idil-addunyaa ta'e fufu.

paragraphs.en: For more information about our tender process or to register as a potential vendor, please contact our procurement department.
paragraphs.am: ስለ ጨረታ ሂደታችን ተጨማሪ መረጃ ለማግኘት ወይም እንደ አቅራቢ ለመመዝገብ፣ እባክዎን የግዥ ክፍላችንን ያግኙ።
paragraphs.om: Odeeffannoo dabalaa waa'ee adeemsa tanzii keenyaa argachuuf ykn akka daldaltootti galmaa'uuf, maaloo kutaa barbaachisaa keenya quunnamaa.
